name: Hamamatsucho Convention Hall
address: Tokyo 105-0013 Nippon Life Hamamatsucho Crea Tower 5F & 6F, 2-3-1 Hamamatsucho, Minato-ku, Tokyo
accessSummary: 2 min walk from the North Exit of Hamamatsucho Station (JR / Tokyo Monorail) / Directly connected to Exit B5 of Daimon Station (Toei Subway Oedo Line / Asakusa Line)
hours: Available hours are in principle 8:00-22:00. The usage categories are all day 9:00-21:00, morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00 and evening 18:00-21:00 (including setup and cleanup time)

ops.prevDaySetup: Advance delivery by courier or mail is accepted only on the day before use, and only if approved after prior notice.
ops.loadingHours: For load-in and load-out, the route and number of vehicles are agreed in advance with the venue staff. Necessary protective covering is to be provided, and work may be stopped if protective covering of the designated areas is not permitted. Users provide their own hand trucks.
ops.vehicleRules: Vehicles for load-in and load-out leave as soon as loading and unloading are finished. Long-term parking is not possible.
ops.waitingRooms: On 5F there are Room 1 (13㎡, hollow square for 6) and Room 2 (24㎡, hollow square for 12). Both can be used when the entire adjacent hall is used; the base usage fee is 40,000 yen for Room 1 and 60,000 yen for Room 2 (excluding tax).
ops.catering: Caterers are designated by the venue. Users are asked not to bring in food or drink other than from the users themselves and the venue's designated vendors. If arranged through the venue, the final number is to be notified by 1 week before the event. A separate bring-in fee applies if video, audio or lighting equipment is brought in.
